svg.title: Obstructive lung disease decision chart: spirometry reversibility separates asthma from chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD); asthma splits into controlled and severe (phenotype to a biologic), COPD into stable and exacerbation; each column gives presentation, numbered investigations and treatment in order
